notes.subject: תשבחם
notes.rationale: שבח can mean 'address in a loud tone' (so 'still/quell', per KJV/Arabic cognate) or 'praise' — some read 'Thou dost praise them', unlikely in context of waves.

notes.subject: גאות
notes.rationale: 'pride/proud swelling' (ASV, JPS) vs 'raging' (KJV, BSB); the Hebrew word is literally 'arrogance, majesty', applied to the sea's surging.

notes.subject: ⟨umía⟩
notes.rationale: Avañeʼẽ verb needs the object pronoun 'umía' explicit, where Hebrew carries it in the suffix -ם of תשבחם.

translation: Nde reisãmbyhy para iñakãraguarete rupive; umi ondyry osẽvo yvateve, nde rejoko ⟨umía⟩.
